task.title: Scaling up the Red Hat Quay from a read-only deployment
task.shortdesc: To exit read-only mode and restore normal operations in Red Hat Quay, you can remove the read-only settings from the config.yaml file and scale the Operator deployment back up.

note.p: Depending on your needs, you might wait to scale up the Red Hat Quay deployment after backing up and restoring your regisry.
